retainedFailures: The first run of the new check on the fixed DLL failed: its click readout was fixed-position text over the heading block and was withheld from rendered evidence, so no click could be confirmed. The readout moved into an in-flow row; the click targets were unchanged.
limitations: Synthetic loopback fixture, disposable profile and real MCP only; no AuthTest native driver or physical input.
Single 100% display-scale monitor with classic 15 CSS px scrollbars. Non-100% display scale and browser zoom were not live-tested; the scale uses the ratio Chromium defines for both.
Pinch zoom is included in the scale, but coordinate validation still uses the unpinched layout viewport, as before.
Right-to-left documents with a left vertical scrollbar and overlay scrollbars were not tested.
Installed packages and publication were not tested.
